Komi-Zyrian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian финн (finn).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈfin/, [ˈfin]
  • Hyphenation: финн

Noun

[edit]

финн • (finn)

  1. Finnish person; Finn
  2. Finnish language

Northern Mansi

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Russian финн (finn).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈfinː]
  • Hyphenation: финн
  • Rhymes: -inn

Noun

[edit]

финн (finn) (Sosva, Sygva, Upper Lozva)

  1. Finnish person; Finn
  2. Finnish language
    Coordinate terms: финн ла̄тыӈ (finn lātyň), финн ма̄сум (finn māsum)

Russian

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Swedish finne.

Pronunciation
